posts.author: rue669
posts.body:
Regular blind works on Hit Rate which works on attack and physical attacks.
I'm trying to create a Blind State that affects only Magic Attacks. Anyone know how to do this? I have the plugin library from VisustellaMZ if that helps. I'm sure there is a way, but can't find it! Thanks!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can use my Custom Hit Formula plugin.
Custom Hit Formula MZ
Custom Hit Formula 1.4 ATT_Turan  Introduction As far as I know, there's still no plugin written with the ability to provide a custom hit formula in MZ, and I got tired of telling people that :wink:  (apparently caethyril actually had one and I didn't know about it! Well, now you can try both...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
You'd make a hit formula that references the magic blind state and paste it into your magic skills.
For example, if your magic blind state is ID 42, the below will make you 50% less likely to hit with that state on.
Code:
<hitformula>
Math.random() < item.successRate * 0.01 - (user.isStateAffected(42) ? .5 : 0)
</hitformula>

posts.author: Ludovinsky
posts.body:
Another way you can achieve this without using a plug in. First, create a new state. Call it like "magic blind" or something like that.
(Then, In the "features" section of this state, you'll want to reduce the character's magic attack or magic accuracy. Unfortunately, MZ doesn't have a built in feature to reduce magic accuracy specifically. However, you can achieve a similar effect by reducing the character's magic attack. This will make their magic attacks less effective, simulating the effect of being "blind".)
So to do this, add a new feature: "parameter - m.atk - Rate- [x]%". Replace [x] with the percentage you want to reduce the character's magic attack by. for example, if you want to reduce it by 50%, you would put 50%.
Now, viola, whenever a character is in the "magic blind" state, their magic attacks will be less effective.

posts.author: Ludovinsky
posts.body:
Haha long day, yeah you're right, but making it 0 does  in a way simulate a miss if it does no damage. I'm not sure how that isn't clear? I still have it going in the correct direction, but it could be more crystal. Let me correct this. In MZ, to simulate a "blind" effect for magic, you could create a state that increases the target's Magic Evasion.
First, create a new state In your database, go to the "states" tab and create a new state. Let's call it "Magic Blind".
Increase Magic Evasion In the "Traits/Features" section of the "Magic Blind" state, add a new trait: "Ex-Parameter-Magic Evasion". Set the rate to a value that suits your game's balance. This will make the affected character more likely to evade magic attacks, simulating the effect of being "blind".
Now apply the state
.
You can apply the "Magic Blind" state to characters using skills, items, or other game mechanics. While I was writing this, I just thought of another way to achieve this. A sort of workaround since MZ doesn't have a default magic blind state like the default physical.
First, create a new state in your database, go to the "States" tab and call it "Magic Blind".
Next, create a conditional branch in each magic skill. Go to the "Skills" tab and open each magic skill. In the "effects" section, add a "conditional branch" that checks if the user is affected by the "Magic Blind" state.
Next, go ahead and change the hit rate, If the user is affected by the "Magic Blind" state, reduce the hit rate of the skill. You can do this by adding a "Change Skill" command in the "Conditional Branch" and setting the hit rate to a lower value.
A final touch up to the idea is to reset the hit rate, If the user is not affected by the "Magic Blind" state, reset the hit rate of the skill to its original value. You do this by adding another "change skill" command outside the conditional branch. This way, when a character is affected by the "magic blind" state, their magic skills will have a lower hit rate, simulating the effect of being "blind". Really many ways to skin this cat
. Hope something helps.
